answer: Put the compiled `.plug.js` in the same folder as your library page, for example `Library/myuser/myplug.plug.js` next to `Library/myuser/My Library`. Then list it under `files:` in the page's frontmatter. `Share: Page` doesn't upload it. It only pushes the library page, so you have to commit the `.plug.js` to the GitHub repository yourself (`Library/Development.md`).
